csv_scope_of_work: Providing Vertical Transportation Consulting Services at Various Sites. This Contract will consist of providing a variety of vertical transportation consulting services for selected vertical transportation work items at various sites, both dwelling and non-dwelling. Architectural, engineering, and other services not specifically identified herein that are ancillary or incidental to the elevator consulting services listed should be anticipated and also included. Work items could include but are not limited to the following: surveying/auditing of existing vertical transportation systems developing a preventive maintenance program for vertical transportation systems monitoring/inspecting/approving preventive maintenance work by contractor developing recommendations and construction documents for modernization and/or replacement of vertical transportation systems monitoring/inspecting/approving modernization or replacement work by contractor
